name: Shield Oath
description: Strike and mark an enemy with Threat Seal, pulling danger toward the Bulwark.

name: Guard Stance
description: Hold the Frontline and reduce the next incoming physical or telegraphed hit.

name: Intervene
description: Take part of a hit meant for an ally. Present in the MVP as a locked reminder until the player levels.

name: Road-Iron Strike
description: A practical shield-and-weapon hit. Not glamorous. Still better than glaring at bones.
